outcome: The TUI behaves like a cockpit instead of a console lock: it attaches to and reconnects with detached runs without ever driving one in its own foreground, keys stay live while work executes, refusals explain themselves in plain language for the codes operators actually hit, and the project's key configuration - the role/profile/model matrix, operator config, records root, paths - is readable in place.

exclude: editing configuration from the TUI (read-first; mutation is a later decision)
runtime or cockpit behaviour changes (this slice consumes S2's detached drive and existing projections)
the event-feed rendering beyond what S5's association exposes

acceptance.text: Starting a run from the TUI uses the detached drive and the screen stays interactive - tick updates continue and keys respond while the run executes: pinned by TUI model fixtures asserting no executing-state key swallowing and live ticks during a run.
Quitting and reopening the TUI reattaches to the still-running run with its live state: pinned by a backend fixture over a run owned by a background drive.

PLAN_NOT_FOUND, INVALID_PLAN_FENCE, REF_NOT_FOUND, and INVALID_HEAD_OBJECT each render a plain-language explanation and next step, and the no-manifest state names the location searched: pinned by view fixtures per code.

A config view shows the resolved role-to-profile/model matrix from drivers.json, the operator config's listen and telemetry endpoints, the records root, and the journal/manifest paths in use, each labelled with its source file: pinned by view fixtures over a fixture project.
Control lockout derives from executability truth, not staleness: a stale-but-controllable board offers its legal actions: pinned by a model fixture.

constraints: The TUI holds no authority: it renders and routes journaled commands; nothing here changes what any action is permitted to do.
Config surfacing is read-only and never displays credential values - sources and shapes, not secrets.

Evidence basis: the TUI's 2-second tick is suppressed and keys are swallowed while executing (internal/tui/model.go:113,140), start drives the TUI's own foreground (cmd/sworn/tui_backend.go:506), four operator-hit codes fall to a generic explanation (internal/tui/view.go:481-501), and lockout keys off staleness (model.go:340) - sworn#172, #169.
Check evidence belongs in the submission's checks field, never in files added to the repository.
